faq.headline: Questions from sending churches and networks.

items.q: Who on our side uses EveryField?
items.a: Sending churches and networks use the same tools. A network also sees each of its sending churches and their plants.

items.q: Do our planters need to use EveryField?
items.a: Yes. Each planter runs their plant in EveryField, and you invite them to connect their plant to your church or network.

items.q: What can we see for each plant?
items.a: Phase, launch date, core group size, gathering rhythm, ministry roles filled and findings, as counts and summaries the plant shares with you.

items.q: Can we see the people in a plant?
items.a: No. You see counts and summaries. Names and personal details stay with the plant.
It reads the findings your plants share and shows patterns across your network: lenses, the phase pipeline and the gap most plants have in common. A pattern needs at least two plants.

items.q: Can we compare plants by state or metro area?
items.a: Yes. Switch between all plants, one state or one metro area, and every number follows.

items.q: Our plant was sent by a church in our network. Who sees it?
items.a: Both the sending church and the network see it.

items.q: A planter came to our network directly. Can we add a sending church later?
items.a: Yes. A network can send a plant on its own and assign a sending church at any time.

items.q: Does EveryField move a plant to the next phase or rate the planter?
items.a: No. The planter sets the phase. EveryField does not change it or grade the planter.

privacy_page.title: Privacy policy
intro: This policy covers everyfield.app, the early access site for EveryField. EveryField LLC runs the site.
The site has no accounts, no sign in and no newsletter. We collect the details you send in an early access request. Our hosting provider also records information about visits, as described below.

sections.heading: What we collect
items: From the planter form: your name, email, church plant name, city and phase. If you add it, your sending church or network.
From the network form: your name, email, network or church and role. If you add them, the number of plants you send or support and your message.
With each request: the date and time, the form you used and your IP address.
When you visit any page: Vercel, our hosting provider, keeps request logs. These include your IP address, your browser type and the page you opened.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
items: To read your request and reply to you about early access.
To decide who joins early access, and when.
To stop spam and repeat requests. We use your email and IP address to limit how many requests can come from one email address or one internet connection.

sections.heading: What we do not do
items: We do not add you to a newsletter or a mailing list.
We do not create an account for you.
We do not sell your information or share it for advertising.
We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Where it is stored and processed
paragraphs: Vercel hosts the site through its global network. Neon stores requests in the United States, and Resend stores email data in the United States. These services may process information outside your country.
items: Vercel hosts the site and runs the forms.
Neon stores each request in a database on Amazon Web Services, in the US East (N. Virginia) region, us-east-1.
Resend sends a copy of each request by email to our team inbox.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
items: We keep each request in our database for 12 months after you send it, then delete it.
We delete the IP addresses we keep for request limits after 30 days.
Our providers may keep service logs and backup copies under their own retention policies.
If you join early access, we will tell you how the product handles your information before you use it.

sections.heading: Ask for a copy, a correction or deletion
paragraphs: Email privacy@everyfield.app to get a copy of your request, to correct it or to delete it. Send the email from the address you used in the form, so we know the request is yours.
We will reply by email about your request.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: The forms are for adults who lead or support church plants. Do not send a request for a child.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we post the new version on this page and change the date at the top.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Send questions about this policy to privacy@everyfield.app.

terms_page.title: Terms
intro: These terms apply to everyfield.app, the early access site for EveryField. EveryField LLC runs the site. When you use the site, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Early access
paragraphs: EveryField is in early access. You cannot sign in or use the product on this site.
A request does not reserve a place. We choose who joins early access and when, and we can say no.
The product will have its own terms. We will give them to you before you use it.

sections.heading: What the site shows
paragraphs: The site describes EveryField as we build it. Features can change before you can use them.
Names and numbers in the product pictures come from a sample church.

sections.heading: Your requests
paragraphs: Send true information that you have the right to share. Request access only for yourself, or for a church or network you represent.

sections.heading: Fair use
items: Do not use the site to send spam, to pose as someone else or to break the law.
Do not try to get around the request limits, overload the site or get into systems you have no right to use.

sections.heading: Our content
paragraphs: The EveryField name, logo, text and pictures on this site belong to EveryField LLC. You can link to any page and share it. Ask us before you copy our content for other uses.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: We provide the site as it is. We work to keep it correct and online, but we do not promise that it is always correct, complete or available.

sections.heading: Limit of liability
paragraphs: As far as the law allows, EveryField LLC is not liable for any loss that comes from your use of this site. These terms do not limit any rights that the law does not let us limit.

sections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: Our privacy policy explains what we collect when you send a request and how to have it deleted.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we change these terms, we post the new version on this page and change the date at the top.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Send questions about these terms to hello@everyfield.app.
